summary: Short flat residential kerb where cars park; homes about 12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Homes on the same side within 12-21 m; the neighbouring plot is cleared but houses flank it.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a parked car on the east edge; room for a van is likely but the stretch is only 12 m.
drivers.traffic: Through road with steady traffic and cars parked both sides.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, so a van would not stand out, but it is a residential frontage.

flags: Low-ish ground (about 46 m) but 139 m from Witton Creek
sun_shade: Open kerb; street trees to the west and north-west give some afternoon shade.

best_section.where: east kerb of Taringa Parade by the empty block near the church
